title: Citrus-Ricotta Oats
description: Oatmeal gets the Italian treatment in this quick and easy recipe flavored with fresh citrus, ricotta cheese, and honey.
ingredients: 0.5 cup Quaker® Oats (Quick or Old Fashioned, uncooked)
2 teaspoons coarsely chopped walnuts, toasted if desired

steps.text: In medium saucepan, bring water to a boil. Stir in oats. Cook uncovered over medium heat, 1 minute for Quick Oats, 5 minutes for Old Fashioned Oats, stirring occasionally until most of the liquid is absorbed. Stir in ricotta, orange zest, and honey. Top with orange segments, walnuts, and brown sugar.
